preconditions.description: The number of cities n must be between 2 and 50,000.
The old and new capital indices r1 and r2 must be distinct and within the range of city indices.
The length of the old road map representation p must be n - 1.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n - 1 numbers representing the new road map.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: All numbers in the output must be valid city indices within the range of 1 to n.
The new road map must correctly represent the path from the new capital r2 to the old capital r1.
